display_name: Observe ledger and tmux metadata divergences
description: Plugin-action dispatch returns immediately with {job_id, status: queued}. A single plugin-owned worker performs the operation. Retain the exact job_id and poll plugin::agent_messaging_plugin::check_choreography_job_status until terminal before consuming the result. The complete response envelope is stored in job.result; failures also retain job.error. Use this read-only report to compare the solet's own session records with metadata from one exact-name tmux probe per distinct recorded host reference. Includes terminal ledger rows, observed panes, source status, bounded coverage and continuation cursors. Sessions no record names are not observed or reported. Native process presence establishes no productive work or recipient uptake. No lifecycle write, identity repair, pane text read or session action.
embedding_description: Asynchronous advisory comparison of a solet's own recorded sessions with exact-name tmux metadata probes. Inspect live and dead pane flags, unresolved operator references, definitive missing sessions, unknown probes and partial ledger coverage. Sessions outside the recorded references are not observed. Recomputed on demand; retain the job handle and retrieve its terminal result.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Immediate receipt: job_id (string), status (queued). The original result described below is available only after job completion. observations retain reason, ledger row and pane metadata. ledger_sources and native_source retain timestamps, completeness, status and cursor evidence. advisories disclose probe_unknown and partial_coverage. complete means bounded source enumeration completed, never active work or an atomic snapshot.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Retain job_id; poll plugin::agent_messaging_plugin::check_choreography_job_status until completed/error/cancelled. Read the report from the terminal job. Preserve uncertain rows and source coverage. matched_process_present requires a pane_dead=0 observation; all-dead joined panes produce matched_native_pane_dead. ledger_tmux_missing requires definitive absence for the recorded reference and complete valid native and ledger coverage. Sessions no record names are not observed or reported. Presence and absence establish no lifecycle, activity or uptake verdict.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Dependent steps must wait for terminal job.result and then consume job.result.data. Handle terminal errors before continuing.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reads StateManagementInterface through existing bounded host-filtered ledger pages and one metadata-only tmux list-panes probe per distinct recorded host reference, using an exact session name. Existing bridge authorization applies, with no new capability or write premise.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Exit 1 beginning with can't find session, error connecting to or no server running establishes absence for that reference. Other exits, timeouts, malformed metadata, invalid references or unavailable ledger evidence yield probe_unknown. partial_coverage preserves the bounded frontier. Unknown evidence establishes no missing/dead or productive-work verdict.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Retain the timestamped report and retry to obtain a new observation. Never adopt a host, terminate a session or infer productive work from these metadata observations.
